calculation_handling.description: Despite 200.5.10.1(1) and 200.5.10.11(1)(C): if a lot has an ancillary building containing a garden suite, no parking spaces are required for any dwelling units and secondary suites in a detached house, semi-detached house, townhouse, detached houseplex or semi-detached houseplex on the same lot.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces the parking space requirements of 200.5.10.1(1) and 200.5.10.11(1)(C) for the listed house types on a lot with a garden suite. There is no lot_condition token for 'has a garden suite' (it is user input has_garden_suite), so the trigger is carried by user_inputs and application, not condition.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 200.5.10.1(1) and 200.5.10.11(1)(C), no parking space is required for a garden suite.
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces the parking space requirements of 200.5.10.1(1) and 200.5.10.11(1)(C) for the garden suite itself.

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building containing a garden suite must provide at least two bicycle parking spaces, within the garden suite or within any required separation distance or required building setbacks for the ancillary building.
calculation_handling.gaps: The minimum is written as the word 'two'; keyed as the numeral 2 units. The location rule (within the suite or the required separation/setbacks) is a design fact and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.80.40(3), if a lot has an ancillary building containing a garden suite, vehicle access to a parking space must be provided from a lawfully existing vehicle access.
calculation_handling.gaps: A non-numeric obligation (REQUIRE in substance), but no vocab.requirement value fits 'access from a lawfully existing vehicle access' (access_from_lane is a different obligation), so it is keyed UNUSUAL and disclosed. The lawfully_existing token refers to the vehicle access, not the building. Overrides 10.5.80.40(3).

units.disclosure: On a lot with a garden suite, any parking must be reached from an existing legal driveway or vehicle access; a new vehicle access cannot be added. We do not hold driveway history, so we do not check this.

150.7.80.1(1).explanation: If a lot has a garden suite, no parking is required for the house or its units (detached, semi-detached, townhouse or houseplex, including secondary suites), and none is required for the garden suite itself.

150.7.80.1(2).explanation: A garden suite must provide at least two bicycle parking spaces, inside the suite or within its required setbacks or separation area.

150.7.80.1(3).explanation: On a lot with a garden suite, any car parking must use an existing legal vehicle access; you cannot add a new one for the suite.
